war_01.name: Squire
war_01.description: A young servant of war learning discipline beside seasoned soldiers. The Squire is not yet a knight, but every battle forges loyalty and courage.

war2_01.name: Footman
war2_01.description: A disciplined infantryman shaped by real battles. The Footman stands firm where weaker troops would break.

war2_02.name: Page
war2_02.description: A noble apprentice carrying the first lessons of command. The Page learns that courage can inspire an entire army.

war3_01.name: Man-at-Arms
war3_01.description: A veteran soldier who understands discipline as instinct. The Man-at-Arms brings order to the front line.

war4_01.name: Champion
war4_01.description: A legendary warrior of noble charge and battlefield glory. The Champion breaks enemy lines through courage and perfect timing.

war4_02.name: Marshal
war4_02.description: A commander whose presence bends morale across the battlefield. The Marshal turns leadership into a weapon.

war_02.name: Fighter
war_02.description: A hardened combatant trained for direct confrontation. The Fighter trusts steel, strength and battlefield instinct.

war2_03.name: Brawler
war2_03.description: A brutal close-combat fighter who turns pressure into victory. The Brawler fights dirty, but effectively.

war2_04.name: Raider
war2_04.description: A fast attacker trained for raids and sudden charges. The Raider favors momentum over caution.

war3_02.name: Berserker
war3_02.description: A warrior who embraces fury as a weapon. The Berserker gains terrifying power, but leaves defense behind.

war4_03.name: Warmaster
war4_03.description: A supreme master of battle tempo. The Warmaster pushes troops beyond normal limits.

war4_04.name: Ravager
war4_04.description: A merciless destroyer who denies enemies the chance to answer. The Ravager exists for brutal, decisive assaults.

war_03.name: Guardian
war_03.description: A defensive warrior sworn to hold the line. The Guardian values survival, formation and patience over reckless attacks.

war2_05.name: Sentinel
war2_05.description: A watchful defender trained to protect allies. The Sentinel reacts before danger fully forms.

war2_06.name: Defender
war2_06.description: A shield-bearing warrior who endures punishment. The Defender believes victory begins with refusing to fall.

war3_03.name: Ironwarden
war3_03.description: An iron-willed protector who refuses to yield. The Ironwarden sacrifices offense to become a living wall.

war4_05.name: Protector
war4_05.description: A guardian of endless resolve. The Protector turns defense into punishment.

war4_06.name: Bastion
war4_06.description: A fortress in human form. The Bastion anchors the army against powerful hostile magic.

war_04.name: Archer
war_04.description: A ranged warrior who studies distance and timing. The Archer survives through precision rather than brute force.

war2_07.name: Marksman
war2_07.description: A ranged specialist trained to focus fire on priority targets. The Marksman turns patience into lethal accuracy.

war2_08.name: Bowmaster
war2_08.description: A master of the bow who watches the field with calm eyes. The Bowmaster guides arrows where chaos blinds others.

war3_04.name: Sharpshooter
war3_04.description: An elite ranged killer able to punish enemies from afar. The Sharpshooter trades mobility for deadly accuracy.

war4_07.name: Deadeye
war4_07.description: A ranged executioner trained for close and distant fire alike. The Deadeye removes the weaknesses of ordinary shooters.

war4_08.name: Hawkeye
war4_08.description: A master of impossible shots. The Hawkeye ignores distance, walls and battlefield obstacles.

mag_01.name: Adept
mag_01.description: A beginning spellcaster touched by arcane force. The Adept has not mastered magic yet, but already feels its danger and protection.

mag2_01.name: Evoker
mag2_01.description: A caster who shapes raw magical force into battle power. The Evoker prefers direct arcane impact over subtle tricks.

mag2_02.name: Arcanist
mag2_02.description: A mage who bends small fragments of time and energy. The Arcanist changes momentum at the right moment.

mag3_01.name: Spellweaver
mag3_01.description: A refined caster who understands the structure of magic. The Spellweaver resists hostile spells through deeper arcane mastery.

mag4_01.name: Archmage
mag4_01.description: A master of all schools and forbidden pages. The Archmage stands above ordinary spell limits.

mag4_02.name: Magister
mag4_02.description: A supreme specialist of elemental force. The Magister shapes destructive magic into battlefield dominance.

mag_02.name: Mystic
mag_02.description: A seeker of hidden signs and unseen patterns. The Mystic trusts intuition, omens and strange luck.

mag2_03.name: Oracle
mag2_03.description: A visionary who reads fortune before it becomes real. The Oracle guides armies through fate and prophecy.

mag2_04.name: Channeler
mag2_04.description: A supportive caster who channels sacred energy through allies. The Channeler strengthens the army through calm magical flow.

mag3_02.name: Visionary
mag3_02.description: A prophet of battle who sees openings others miss. The Visionary turns insight into fortune.

mag4_03.name: Seer
mag4_03.description: A prophet protected by reflected destiny. The Seer turns hostile magic back through mirrors of fate.

mag4_04.name: Fatebinder
mag4_04.description: A binder of magical permanence. The Fatebinder protects enchantments from being erased.

mag_03.name: Scholar
mag_03.description: A student of forgotten texts and old rituals. The Scholar gains power through knowledge and patience.

mag2_05.name: Sage
mag2_05.description: A learned caster who weakens enemies with precise words of power. The Sage wins before the first strike lands.

mag2_06.name: Loremaster
mag2_06.description: A keeper of old magical traditions. The Loremaster uses protective knowledge to preserve the army.

mag3_03.name: Archivist
mag3_03.description: A keeper of ancient knowledge and sealed mysteries. The Archivist protects the army through wisdom gathered across ages.

mag4_05.name: Runesmith
mag4_05.description: A craftsman of runes and sealed wards. The Runesmith blocks higher hostile magic with ancient symbols.

mag4_06.name: Chronicler
mag4_06.description: A keeper of timeless records. The Chronicler stretches enchantments beyond their normal duration.

mag_04.name: Druid
mag_04.description: A keeper of natural magic bound to living forces. The Druid strengthens life, but moves with the slower rhythm of nature.

mag2_07.name: Grovekeeper
mag2_07.description: A defender of groves, stones and roots. The Grovekeeper calls on earthbound magic to shield allied troops.

mag2_08.name: Spiritcaller
mag2_08.description: A voice between the living and unseen spirits. The Spiritcaller chills enemies with otherworldly force.

mag3_04.name: Hierophant
mag3_04.description: A sacred caster who channels life through divine authority. The Hierophant strengthens troops through ritual endurance.

mag4_07.name: Stormcaller
mag4_07.description: A storm-touched caster who amplifies elemental violence. The Stormcaller turns air and water into weapons of ruin.

mag4_08.name: Lifebinder
mag4_08.description: A vessel of renewing power. The Lifebinder draws mana as if from an endless well.

adv_01.name: Scout
adv_01.description: A careful explorer trained to read terrain and danger. The Scout moves quickly, but avoids relying on heavy protection.

adv2_01.name: Pathfinder
adv2_01.description: A guide through dangerous terrain and sudden openings. The Pathfinder helps the army move when movement matters most.

adv2_02.name: Trailblazer
adv2_02.description: A hardened roadmaker who turns hostile ground into advantage. The Trailblazer prepares the path before others arrive.

adv3_01.name: Wayfinder
adv3_01.description: A master of roads, trails and hidden passages. The Wayfinder turns movement into strategic power.

adv4_01.name: Guide
adv4_01.description: A supreme pathfinder who understands every road and shortcut. The Guide turns terrain into an ally.

adv4_02.name: Horizon Walker
adv4_02.description: A traveler beyond ordinary limits. The Horizon Walker moves as if the world itself opens before them.

adv_02.name: Ranger
adv_02.description: A wilderness survivor who hunts by instinct. The Ranger strikes hard from harsh lands and open roads.

adv2_03.name: Hunter
adv2_03.description: A patient tracker of prey and weak points. The Hunter waits, aims and strikes when the target is exposed.

adv2_04.name: Beastmaster
adv2_04.description: A master of beasts, instincts and primal courage. The Beastmaster awakens savage force within allied creatures.

adv3_02.name: Wildstalker
adv3_02.description: A predator of the wild who hunts weakness without hesitation. The Wildstalker gains power through instinct and patience.

adv4_03.name: Tracker
adv4_03.description: A hunter who marks the enemy before battle fully begins. The Tracker exposes weak points with ruthless focus.

adv4_04.name: Falconer
adv4_04.description: A master of skyward signs and hunting birds. The Falconer turns distance into retaliation.

adv_03.name: Merchant
adv_03.description: A trader of chances, routes and battlefield opportunity. The Merchant trusts luck and profit more than raw strength.

adv2_05.name: Trader
adv2_05.description: A gambler of war and profit. The Trader knows when a lucky deal can shift the entire battle.

adv2_06.name: Quartermaster
adv2_06.description: A supplier and organizer of armies on the march. The Quartermaster turns preparation into survival.

adv3_03.name: Guildmaster
adv3_03.description: A leader of trade routes, contacts and hidden support. The Guildmaster wins through networks others cannot see.

adv4_05.name: Broker
adv4_05.description: A negotiator whose contracts survive even the chaos of war. The Broker makes surrender cheaper and survival easier.

adv4_06.name: Magnate
adv4_06.description: A ruler of trade, supply and wealth. The Magnate turns resources into long-term power.

adv_04.name: Wanderer
adv_04.description: A restless traveler who refuses to stay bound to one road. The Wanderer moves freely, but lacks the morale of settled armies.

adv2_07.name: Nomad
adv2_07.description: A swift wanderer of open roads and harsh lands. The Nomad keeps the army moving when others slow down.

adv2_08.name: Explorer
adv2_08.description: An explorer with a sharp eye for opportunity. The Explorer finds the precise moment to strike.

adv3_04.name: Voyager
adv3_04.description: A traveler who treats the world itself as a road. The Voyager endures distance better than ordinary heroes.

adv4_07.name: Pioneer
adv4_07.description: A founder of new roads, ports and frontiers. The Pioneer crosses barriers that stop ordinary armies.

adv4_08.name: Cartographer
adv4_08.description: A master of maps, borders and hidden lands. The Cartographer sees the world as no ordinary hero can.

hyb_01.name: Battlemage
hyb_01.description: A disciplined warrior-scholar who trains steel and spell side by side. The Battlemage stands between the front line and the arcane circle, turning martial order into magical force.

hyb2_01a.name: Arcane Sergeant
hyb2_01a.description: An officer of arcane warfare who drills troops through magic and command. The Arcane Sergeant inspires aggression while keeping battlefield rhythm under control.

hyb2_01b.name: War Mage
hyb2_01b.description: A combat caster who favors practical destruction over pure study. The War Mage enters battle to solve problems with immediate arcane impact.

hyb3_01.name: Battle Magister
hyb3_01.description: A veteran of campaigns where spellcraft and discipline have become one art. The Battle Magister blends tactical force with refined magical control.

hyb4_01a.name: Eldritch Warlord
hyb4_01a.description: A conqueror whose will drives both armies and enchanted violence. The Eldritch Warlord rules through relentless force backed by forbidden battlecraft.

hyb4_01b.name: Arcane Commander
hyb4_01b.description: A supreme commander who strengthens allies through strategic sorcery. The Arcane Commander leads not by rage, but by precise magical authority.

hyb_02.name: Spellblade
hyb_02.description: A knight of enchanted arms who trusts both blade discipline and warding signs. The Spellblade survives through balance, resolve and controlled mysticism.

hyb2_02a.name: Runeblade
hyb2_02a.description: A warrior who carves ancient sigils into battle. The Runeblade treats every strike and every defense as part of a living rune.

hyb2_02b.name: Spell Duelist
hyb2_02b.description: A swift duelist who fights between footwork and spell timing. The Spell Duelist wins through tempo, reaction and precise magical support.

hyb3_02.name: Spell Knight
hyb3_02.description: A hardened champion whose body, weapon and ward act as one. The Spell Knight turns battlefield pressure into disciplined magical endurance.

hyb4_02a.name: Arcane Champion
hyb4_02a.description: A heroic swordsman crowned by elemental force. The Arcane Champion charges with the confidence of a knight and the fury of a storm.

hyb4_02b.name: Runic Champion
hyb4_02b.description: A master of ancient battle marks and protective fire. The Runic Champion binds victory through symbols older than kingdoms.

hyb_03.name: Warden
hyb_03.description: A frontier defender who stands where road, wall and wilderness meet. The Warden protects others through endurance, vigilance and mobility.

hyb2_03a.name: Wild Guardian
hyb2_03a.description: A guardian of wild borders who knows the patience of beasts and the duty of shields. The Wild Guardian survives by turning nature into protection.

hyb2_03b.name: Trail Defender
hyb2_03b.description: A defender of roads and passes who controls hostile ground. The Trail Defender keeps allies alive by mastering terrain before the enemy does.

hyb3_03.name: Frontier Warden
hyb3_03.description: A veteran keeper of marches, forests and remote strongholds. The Frontier Warden treats every path as a line worth defending.

hyb4_03a.name: Oathwarden
hyb4_03a.description: A sworn protector whose vow outlasts pain and exhaustion. The Oathwarden answers danger with endless retaliation and unbroken resolve.

hyb4_03b.name: Wild Oathkeeper
hyb4_03b.description: A sacred defender bound to the old wilds. The Wild Oathkeeper carries a protective covenant that shields allies from lesser sorcery.

hyb_04.name: Skirmisher
hyb_04.description: A fast raider who lives by momentum rather than formation. The Skirmisher strikes, withdraws and returns before the enemy regains order.

hyb2_04a.name: Raider Scout
hyb2_04a.description: A scout bred for rapid strikes across exposed flanks. The Raider Scout opens battles through movement, surprise and predatory timing.

hyb2_04b.name: Ambusher
hyb2_04b.description: A hunter of weak positions and isolated prey. The Ambusher prefers patience, concealment and a single decisive opening.

hyb3_04.name: Shadow Skirmisher
hyb3_04.description: A battlefield predator who has perfected hit-and-run warfare. The Shadow Skirmisher turns speed into pressure and fear into opportunity.

hyb4_04a.name: Storm Raider
hyb4_04a.description: A mounted storm of speed and impact. The Storm Raider smashes through lines with charging force and sudden elemental violence.

hyb4_04b.name: Shadow Raider
hyb4_04b.description: A silent executioner who denies the enemy a fair response. The Shadow Raider appears at the fatal angle and leaves no room for retaliation.

hyb_05.name: Arcane Wanderer
hyb_05.description: A traveler guided by hidden currents of magic. The Arcane Wanderer follows forgotten routes, ley traces and strange roads between places.

hyb2_05a.name: Mystic Rover
hyb2_05a.description: A roaming mystic who survives by intuition and subtle blessings. The Mystic Rover treats every road as part of a larger magical pattern.

hyb2_05b.name: Ley Scout
hyb2_05b.description: A scout who reads invisible veins of power beneath the world. The Ley Scout reaches key ground first because the land itself seems to guide them.

hyb3_05.name: Ley Wanderer
hyb3_05.description: A seasoned traveler of enchanted roads and silent borders. The Ley Wanderer moves as if distance and magic have entered a pact.

hyb4_05a.name: Worldshaper
hyb4_05a.description: A shaper of terrain, route and magical impact. The Worldshaper does not merely cross the world — they impose will upon it.

hyb4_05b.name: Leymaster
hyb4_05b.description: A keeper of the deepest arcane paths. The Leymaster commands echoes, doubles and long-lasting enchantments through mastery of hidden lines.

hyb_06.name: Seeker
hyb_06.description: A hunter of secrets, relics and old power. The Seeker walks between scholarship and adventure, guided by curiosity stronger than fear.

hyb2_06a.name: Relic Seeker
hyb2_06a.description: A wanderer drawn to forgotten treasures and sealed devices. The Relic Seeker believes the right artifact can change an entire war.

hyb2_06b.name: Rune Seeker
hyb2_06b.description: A pathfinder of old inscriptions and magical signs. The Rune Seeker follows symbols that others cannot read.

hyb3_06.name: Arcane Seeker
hyb3_06.description: A veteran explorer of ruins, sanctums and star-marked roads. The Arcane Seeker sees patterns of power where ordinary eyes see only dust.

hyb4_06a.name: Astral Pathfinder
hyb4_06a.description: A guide who crosses impossible routes between the known and the astral. The Astral Pathfinder opens ways that ordinary travelers never find.

hyb4_06b.name: Relic Pathfinder
hyb4_06b.description: A master treasure-hunter whose knowledge extends across the whole world. The Relic Pathfinder can track both prey and power through land itself.

hyb_07.name: Deathbinder
hyb_07.description: A dark adept who binds death and discipline into one doctrine. The Deathbinder studies decay not as chaos, but as a force to command.

hyb2_07a.name: Grave Adept
hyb2_07a.description: A servant of tombs, ash and battlefield remains. The Grave Adept spreads weakness through the cold authority of the grave.

hyb2_07b.name: Soul Acolyte
hyb2_07b.description: A novice of soul rites who listens to the suffering behind mortality. The Soul Acolyte undermines enemies by touching the spirit beneath the flesh.

hyb3_07.name: Soulbinder
hyb3_07.description: A sinister master of bound essence and disciplined necromantic force. The Soulbinder joins fear, damage and resistance in one grim pact.

hyb4_07a.name: Deathbinder Lord
hyb4_07a.description: A tyrant of gravefire and battlefield despair. The Deathbinder Lord spreads ruin while breaking the enemy's will to resist.

hyb4_07b.name: Soulreaper Lord
hyb4_07b.description: A harvester of terror whose presence chills the living. The Soulreaper Lord rules through fear, frenzy and the certainty of death.
